difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's cor  (source0.tex lines 244-246). The statement reads: cor Let be an m n half-grid, with m n . Then the minimum number of lines required to cover every point of at least k times is at least mk (1-e - n m -O( n m 2 ) ) . cor. The retained complete proof (lines 247-417, 171 lines) is the article's own argument, retained line for line. It is a research-level argument in this field: it is not a routine verification but a complete proof whose steps (case analysis, intermediate estimates, comparison or induction arguments as the source words them) must all be carried out before the statement follows, which places it above ordinary PhD qualifying exercises, where such results are quoted rather than proved.
